title: DEgenerative ROtator Cuff Disease and Botulinum TOXin
official: DEgenerative ROtator Cuff Disease and Botulinum TOXin: a Randomized Trial
summary: The aim of the study is to assess the effectiveness of botulinum toxin in persistent shoulder pain due to degenerative rotator cuff disease.

interventions.name: The investigational medicinal product is incobotulinumtoxinA (XEOMIN®).
